Babaattitude of gratitude
Blind Soccer

Q: What do you love doing, Baba?

B: Playing soccer.

Q: So, what’s your greatest challenge about playing the game?

B: People might say my biggest challenge is that I’m blind! The most stressful part of playing soccer is that the world does not see us. It feels as if we are in our own bubble.

Baba can’t see. He is captain of his blind soccer team—a leader among his teammates and a follower of Jesus. His favorite Bible verse is Philippians 4:13. He always tries to show people “Christ gives me the strength to face anything.” God helps him always, but he has realized he needs to work hard and use what God has given him to play well and inspire others who have disabilities.

He has many challenges, but Baba says, “Blindness doesn’t limit my practice of expressing gratitude to God. I’ve learned that giving thanks is important to experience joy and peace.”

Think about this:

What are you thankful for right now? Is it something you can thank God for?
